_: Which pack each biome of the layout is generated from. 'order': the first provider in this list that ships the vanilla biome for 26.3 wins ('vanilla' always has it), so a newer Overrealm that covers more biomes takes them over from Geophilic by itself. 'biomes': exceptions per layout biome - a provider, e.g. {"minecraft:taiga": "geophilic"} (or "vanilla"), or another biome id for all islands of that biome, e.g. {"minecraft:meadow": "orealm:some_new_biome"}. 'islands': another biome id for single islands, e.g. {"A6": "orealm:some_new_biome"}; any vanilla biome or biome file of a pack in vendor/. An id nobody has is reported by the build and the island keeps its biome. 'drop_features': placed features (fnmatch patterns) taken out of the provider biomes because they cannot work on the islands; the reasons are in 'drop_reasons'. 'cave_world': the pack whose cave world is built into an island (tools/build_caves.py), when it is in vendor/. See README.md, 'Biome packs'.

drop_reasons.orealm:spring/ocean_caves: 64 water springs per chunk meant for flooded ocean caves: the sea basins have no caves under them, and in the other islands they would run out of the underside (seen as water columns under d5 and M5)
